text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival! The Umamusume are participating 
in all sorts of events to entertain their 
fans—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Runaway Sisters... Fiiiiiight, ohhh!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
In this 'Front Runner vs. Chaser Tag' 
match, our special unit is taking the 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, Suzuka-chan!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa...! We will do a 'hip-hip-hooray' 
too~. CB-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's enjoy this opportunity to the 
fullest!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ines, Suzuka! Pull way ahead~~! C.B., 
Bright, don't you dare lose either~!

The stands were packed with spectators for 
the event Ines Fuujin was participating 
in, featuring a showdown between Front 
Runners and Chasers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright! Your adductors are developing 
nicely too! Keep your focus on your 
footwork transitions!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, we must get moving soon. Our talk 
show is going to start before we know it, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa!? You're right!? Sorry, I 
completely lost track of time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Are you worried about Bright's big 
moment?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Rather than worry, I'm just full of 
anticipation!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She's watched our backs all this time. I 
know she'll do what needs to be done!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...You've grown quite dependable, haven't 
you? It's like you're an entirely 
different person from before your debut."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"In a post-race interview previously, you 
said, 'The current me is not an Umamusume 
the Mejiro family can be proud of.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yet you already— have a back worthy of 
carrying the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. I never thought the day would 
come where you'd praise me like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“I think it's also because I've always 
been given an environment where I could 
train and push myself, though.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I just focused completely on winning. The 
muscle to do that naturally developed over 
time on its own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Not only that, but I also believe it's 
because you possessed the resolve 
yourself."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And I have my pride as well. I vowed to 
dedicate the shield of the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) to my family with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I know! But I'm not gonna lose! Come 
on, let's head to the venue too!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now then, for the 'Front Runner vs. Chaser 
Tag'! The Chaser Umamusume have locked 
their sights on their respective targets!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *gasp*!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, C.B.-san just came right over 
here!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown Umamusume is closing in 
on Ines Fuujin! What a terrifying burst of 
speed! Will she be able to hold her lead 
to the finish!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, C.B.-chan is really fired up! 
Ines-chan, do your best-o~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-But, could this end up traumatizing 
Ines-chan... or something!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Getting blasted by that kind of aura from 
behind... If you started thinking, 'I'm 
done running as a Front Runner!', wouldn't 
that be super sad!? Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it doesn't look like you need to worry 
about that. Look. Just see the look on her 
face—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What will Ines Fujin do now?! Mr. C.B. 
reaches out toward her back—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh, so frustrating~~~!!

Ines Fujin slumps down limply as if her 
strength is completely drained, yet her 
voice doesn't tremble in the slightest.
choice_data_list:
Next time, I'll pull off a wire-to-wire 
win!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep trying again and again! As long 
as I'm given the chance, over and over!

Her spirited declaration earned a round of 
applause from the spectators as well.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it doesn't look like you need to worry 
about that. Look. Just see the look on her 
face—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What will Ines Fujin do now?! Mr. C.B. is 
reaching out to touch her back!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Crap! I gotta pick up the speed...! I 
need to spin my legs faster and 
faster...!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Now, catch—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Mm...? But maybe... if this is the 
deciding moment...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Ines Fujin decelerates! Mr. 
C.B.'s hand grabs empty air!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Aha♪

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And Ines Fujin pivots just like that! 
Brilliantly playing the Triple Crown 
Umamusume like a fiddle!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Over here, Mr. Demon♪ It is, yep!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aha, now that's... pretty interesting!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Challenge accepted!

Their game of tag continues to heat up. 
The gathered fans cheer loudly, watching 
their showdown unfold—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... I'm completely wiped out~... I 
gave it everything I had, nano~...!
choice_data_list: Nice work with that mid-race strategy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right? I tried "holding back" that 
urge to rush forward. Resisting the 
temptation to step on the gas at full 
throttle!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Like applying what I learned last 
summer! Thanks to that, I feel like my 
stamina lasted longer than usual!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, honestly, I don't know if I can run 
like this in the actual race, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure nothing you do ever goes to 
waste. So please keep teaching me all 
sorts of things!

Amidst loud applause from the stands, I 
exchanged a high five with Ines Fujin as 
she happily gave her report.
